bathAction.title: Wash mound
bathAction.tooltip: Wash the smooth mound between the thighs.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(wash)] the smooth mound between [npc.her] thighs, palm flat, gentle and thorough. [npc.She] [npc.verb(rinse)] [npc.herHim] until the skin is clean and warm. [npc.speech(Gentle. There is nothing to dig at. Just wash it.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(cup)] the mound between [npc.her] thighs and [npc.verb(let)] the hot water run over [npc.her] hand. [npc.She] [npc.verb(sigh)] and [npc.verb(stay)] there longer than the washing needs. [npc.speech(The heat feels lovely right there.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(scrub)] the mound between [npc.her] thighs in two hard passes and [npc.verb(rinse)] it off. [npc.speech(It is clean. Leave it alone.)]
